substantiveCommits.summary: Add physical window occupancy variation pass
Record window dressing manufacture and PBR contract
Add scene clone-risk and repetition preflight
Define causal scene repetition QA policy
Enforce occupancy variation and clone QA on benchmark saves

implementation.problem: The exterior housing construction is authentically modular, but identical visible room cards behind all thirty windows would create a synthetic clone rhythm. Natural tree/ecology assemblies also needed an explicit source-level clone-risk preflight rather than relying only on random seeds.

windowDressing.deterministicLayoutRule: curtain gap, left/right gather, hem height and cloth family derive from floor/bay hash while manufactured sash dimensions remain unchanged

staticRepetitionQA.ground: reuses existing metre-derived macro/detail scale and world-phase validator
staticRepetitionQA.apartments: minimum 18 unique LOD0 signatures; maximum 3 exact repeats
staticRepetitionQA.generatedTrees: root-normalized mesh/material/transform hierarchy fingerprints must be unique among active generated fallbacks
staticRepetitionQA.ecologyPatches: minimum 5 unique fingerprints across six patches; maximum 2 exact matches
staticRepetitionQA.falsePositiveControl: mass-produced sash/rail/curb/fastener repetition remains explicitly approved when construction causality supports it

implementation.enforcement: InitializeOnLoad sceneSaving gate runs after GroundHighDetail and DanchiFacadeOptics exist. The current physical-environment build saves the scene after facade optics, so the 4K preparation path cannot persist a generated benchmark without occupancy variation and clone-risk validation.

notes: Static fingerprint uniqueness does not prove perceptual uniqueness in a rendered frame.
Transparent-glass sorting, fabric moire, curtain over-contrast and LOD transitions are not observable without Unity runtime evidence.
No render-quality claim is made from source coverage.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Period accuracy/scene authenticity: occupant-controlled interior variation breaks cloned-window rhythm without falsifying repeated housing construction.
Geometry & construction fidelity: curtain gap, physical pleats, track and optical depth are actual geometry/spacing, not painted shading.
Material/PBR plausibility: dry curtain textile and coated track are dielectric, non-emissive and separated from glass reflections.
Texture/microdetail: LOD0 textile uses metre-derived UVs and yarn-scale normal/albedo rather than per-window stretched cards.
Vegetation/natural complexity: exact generated-tree/ecology hierarchy clones become a save-blocking QA failure.
Temporal/LOD stability: window dressing explicitly supplies LOD0/1/2/3 animated cross-fade, pending runtime visual proof.
nextBlocker: Obtain a real Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile and native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing captures. Immediately stop speculative expansion when they exist; inspect facade_center/facade_right for curtain moire/repetition and glass sorting, balcony_services for optical depth, and vegetation_grounding/tree_shadow_contact for perceptual clones. Then score/fix only from rendered evidence.
stopPolicy: No new commits on/after 2026-09-19 unless new instructions arrive.
